hooks.name: Property test sync
hooks.description: When pure shared logic changes, make sure its Correctness Property test still exists and still states the same rule.

action.prompt: A pure logic file in shared/src was saved. Find any Correctness Property in .kiro/specs/*/design.md that this file implements (search for its exported function names). For each, confirm a property test exists with the matching '// Feature: <spec>, Property <N>' comment and that it still exercises the changed behaviour. If a test is missing or stale, update or add only the test file. Never edit requirements.md or design.md from this hook; if the code now contradicts a requirement, report the conflict instead. Do not touch files unrelated to this change.
